subject: Incident evidence preservation and expedited delivery request — Greenseed spike
messages:
From: Olivia Martin <olivia@greenseedpayments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: spike this morning — request for preserved traces and custody notes

Kimberly,

Thanks for the call earlier. We experienced a significant set of 504s and elevated token latency across several payment routes between 08:34–09:05 PDT this morning. Our compliance team is asking for the following, and they need an auditable package for executive review:  

- Full request/response traces (headers + timing) for the window 2027-08-03 08:30:00 to 09:10:00 PDT, sampled at 100% for our tenant IDs GS-748*, plus 1-minute aggregated telemetry for 30 minutes before/after.
- A manifest describing where logs are stored, retention policy, and the chain-of-custody (who accessed artifacts and timestamps).
- SHA256 hashes for any exported artifacts and a signed delivery (S3 pre-signed link or secure Drive link) to our audit mailbox (audit@greenseed.com).
- Confirmation that no logs from this export left the us-west-2 region and that any PII fields are redacted or that you will provide a redaction plan and sample before export.

We need the package for an executive briefing Monday morning (2027-08-09 09:00 PDT). If Redwood can provide a timeline for preservation, extraction, and delivery and any gating legal docs you require, that will help our legal/compliance team.

Attachment: sample_request_ids.txt (list of request IDs we observed)

—Olivia Martin
Director of Reliability, Greenseed Payments
olivia@greenseedpayments.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Martin <olivia@greenseedpayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: spike this morning — request for preserved traces and custody notes

Olivia — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We will preserve the requested artifacts immediately. Action items from our side:  

1) Preservation: I have placed a legal hold and flagged the inference runtime telemetry for a preservation snapshot of 2027-08-03 08:00–09:30 PDT. We will not delete or rotate the relevant buckets until we confirm delivery with Greenseed.

2) Scoping: Ben (Security/Forensics) will confirm the exact files we can export and whether we need a signed data-sharing addendum prior to transfer.

3) Delivery options: we can provide either an encrypted S3 export (us-west-2) with pre-signed, time-limited links + SHA256 manifest, or deliver via our secure transfer workspace (Drive link with restricted viewers). Please indicate preference; if you require cross-account S3 access we will need the receiving bucket info and an acceptance email from audit@greenseed.com.

4) Redaction: we can provide both raw traces and a redacted copy. If you want us to run automated redaction before export, confirm which fields you consider PII (card holder name, email, phone, full PAN). Otherwise we will deliver raw and a separate redaction log.

I will follow up with a firm timeline once Ben confirms artifact availability. Rest assured we prioritize meeting your Monday exec deadline.

—Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Martin <olivia@greenseedpayments.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: spike this morning — request for preserved traces and custody notes

Kimberly/Marissa/Olivia — quick forensics note:  

What we can produce (standard playbook):
- Per-tenant request/response traces (raw JSON logs) for the specified window. Files are stored in internal cold buckets (us-west-2).
- Inference runtime KV/cache traces and scheduler logs (limited size) where we saw queuing at the inference-serving layer.
- Aggregated telemetry (percentile latencies, error counts) from our metrics backend at 1-minute granularity.
- Access audit: a generated chain-of-custody CSV showing which Redwood principals/roles touched the export and timestamps.

Estimated timeline (if we begin now):
- Preservation snapshot: within 1 hour (done).
- Extraction & initial manifest (hashes + file list): 6–8 hours.
- Redaction pass (if requested): +3–4 hours.
- Secure upload to a pre-shared S3 bucket or Drive: +1 hour after extraction.

Requirements from Greenseed for transfer:
- Confirmation of preferred delivery method (S3 vs secure Drive).
- Confirmation that audit@greenseed.com will accept the files and confirm receipt.
- If Greenseed requires us to run a PII redaction step prior to export, we need a short redaction spec (field names).

Notes on cryptographic proof: we will provide SHA256 hashes for every artifact and an overall manifest. For extra assurance we can also provide a signed statement (PGP) from Redwood Security correlating file names -> hashes.

Attachments: extraction_plan.md (stub), example_custody_csv.csv (stub)

—Ben Carter
Director, Security Forensics (Redwood Inference)
From: Olivia Martin <olivia@greenseedpayments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Greenseed Payments Audit <audit@greenseed.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: spike this morning — request for preserved traces and custody notes

Thanks Ben — we prefer an S3 export into our audit bucket (audits-greenseed-logs-uswest2). Audit will accept the files; please share an acceptance confirmation to audit@greenseed.com once the pre-signed link is ready.

We will sign any short-form transfer addendum you need. For redaction, please remove full PANs and mask email addresses (replace local-part with ****). Names and timestamps are OK to keep.

Also urgent: can Redwood provide a short executive-facing one-page summary of what happened (root-cause hypothesis, impact scope by route, and mitigation steps) for our CTO and board? That should accompany the evidence package by Monday morning.

—Olivia
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: spike this morning — request for preserved traces and custody notes

Kimberly/Ben — thank you for the quick triage. I approve prioritizing Greenseed's package. Please treat the extraction as high priority and coordinate with Legal for the short-form transfer addendum; I want an executive summary drafted by EOD Thursday (2027-08-05) so we have time for internal review before delivery. Ben, loop Soojin from incident response if you need extra hands on telemetry extraction.

I'll be available to review the one-pager and sign off for exec distribution. Keep me posted on any blockers.

—Jonas Weber
VP, Customer Reliability Operations (Redwood Inference)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Martin <olivia@greenseedpayments.com>, audit@greenseed.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: incident evidence preservation — delivery plan and timeline (Greenseed)

Olivia — summary and firm plan below. We will deliver the artifacts to audits-greenseed-logs-uswest2 once we receive the short-form transfer addendum signed by Greenseed.

Preservation confirmation:
- Snapshot preserved: telemetry and request logs for 2027-08-03 08:00–09:30 PDT (preserved as of 2027-08-03T10:00:00-07:00).

Deliverables and timeline (committed):
- Extraction & manifest (file list + SHA256 hashes): by 2027-08-05 22:00 PDT. Attachment: evidence_manifest_20270803.csv (manifest + hashes).
- Redaction pass (masking PANs, masking email local-parts): optional; will run within 3 hours of manifest if you confirm.
- Secure delivery: encrypted S3 export to audits-greenseed-logs-uswest2 and pre-signed links emailed to audit@greenseed.com by 2027-08-06 02:00 PDT (or earlier).
- Executive one-pager: draft to Greenseed and internal execs for review by 2027-08-05 23:59 PDT.

Attachments (stubs): runtime-trace-20270803.tar.gz (contains per-tenant traces, guarded), hashes_20270803.txt (SHA256 list), evidence_manifest_20270803.csv.

Next steps for Greenseed: please return the signed short-form transfer addendum to legal@redwood.com and confirm whether you want the pre-export redaction. Once we have the addendum and confirmation for redaction, we will begin upload and notify audit@greenseed.com with pre-signed link(s) and the manifest.

If you prefer, we can also schedule a 30-min exec sync Friday morning to walk through the one-pager and the artifacts.

Best —
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
